verdict.rationale: BVNK's documented product is stablecoin *payments/acceptance/settlement* infrastructure (wallets, on/off-ramp, embedded wallets, virtual accounts) — not a white-label stablecoin issuance product covering minting, redemption, and reserve management for a founder to launch their own branded token. No evidence describes issuing a new stablecoin, reserve attestation, or redemption mechanics.
